purpose: Unedited Pythia1B capability on external semantic city attributes before source intervention selection
budget: At most20minutes managed GPU wall, existing Pythia1B; about16000 short prompt forwards without storing full hidden-state/full-vocabulary caches; no new weights or paid cost.
screening_rule: Before observing results, candidate source intervention work will prefer original-train entities with at least2of3 first-token answers correct for every one of Country/Continent/Language. Structural demonstration/boundary exclusions retained. This is model-knowledge conditioning, not a source/target intervention selection.
scope: Original RAVEL city dictionaries and split metadata read; only official train entities and nine official train templates undergo model inference. First-answer-token correctness is measured on all selected rows, not full-answer generation accuracy or full RAVEL benchmark replication. All unedited failures retained. No SAE training or intervention/target outcome influences this capability screen.
